title: Bugfix: dispatch KeyError 'routed-findings' in spawn._shadow_route / context_router.section_items when a task's merged dependency carries a result (T-1270 failed at dispatch)
spec: On main, dispatching T-1270 (depends_on T-1252, merged with a result) failed with dispatch error KeyError 'routed-findings'. spawn._shadow_route builds _routed_sections for the fixed section tuple (gotchas, decisions, evidence, read_scope, routed-findings) via context_router.section_items(routed, by_id, section) in active mode. Reproduce with a unit test: a task with one merged dependency whose result is routed as routed-findings evidence, context_router mode active; find the mapping that lacks the routed-findings key (in context_router.section_items or the section map it consults) and make section_items return an empty list for a section it has no items or no mapping for, never raise; keep every other section's behaviour. Add the regression test to tests/test_spawn.py or tests/test_context_router.py (whichever exercises the failing path) and a line in docs/hermes-hardening/00-audit.md is not needed. Repository rules: unittest, no new dependencies, run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh . until green, do not ask questions.
acceptance: tests/test_spawn.py::test_shadow_route_active_with_dependency_result_never_raises (task with a merged dependency result; active mode; packet builds and routed sections include routed-findings)
